title: Eager Loading aur N+1 Problem
objectives: N+1 query problem samajhna aur pehchanna
Nested aur constrained eager loading likhna
prerequisites: Has Many Through aur Polymorphic Relations (m08-l03)

sections.heading: N+1 problem kya hai?
sections.body: Maan lo 50 posts ki list dikhani hai, har post ke saath author ka naam. Agar tum seedha `$post->user->name` likhte ho, to Laravel 1 query posts ke liye aur **har post ke liye alag query** user ke liye chalata hai: kul 1 + 50 = 51 queries. Isko **N+1 problem** kehte hain, aur ye project ko dheema bana deta hai.

callout.text: Relationship ko property se pehli baar padhne par query chalti hai (lazy loading). Loop ke andar yeh mehenga padta hai.

sections.heading: Eager loading: with()
sections.body: `with()` ek saath saare related records laa deta hai: sirf 2 queries.
explain: `with('user')` – 1 query posts, 1 query users (`WHERE id IN (...)`).
`'comments.user'` – comments aur har comment ka user bhi.
`with('user:id,name')` mein foreign/primary key (`id`) hona zaroori hai, warna relation match nahi hoga.

sections.heading: load, loadMissing aur $with
sections.body: Model/collection pehle se mil chuka ho to baad mein bhi eager load kar sakte ho. Hamesha chahiye ho to model par default set karo.

callout.text: `$with` har query mein relation load karta hai, to sirf wahi rakho jo hamesha chahiye.

sections.heading: N+1 ko development mein pakadna
sections.body: Development mein lazy loading par error do, taaki N+1 galti turant dikhe:
explain: Ab lazy load par `LazyLoadingViolationException` aayega, development mein hi (production mein nahi).
Naye Laravel versions mein optional 'automatic eager loading' bhi hai. Official relationships docs mein us section ko dekho, par pehle `with()` achhe se seekho.

versionDiff.heading: Eager loading: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: `with()`, `load()`, `loadMissing()` aur `preventLazyLoading` teeno versions mein kaam karte hain.

items.13: Same as 11. 13 ke API docs mein relationship auto-loading ka support bhi dikhta hai (optional feature, docs dekho).

errors.error: Attempted to lazy load [user] on model [App\Models\Post] but lazy loading is disabled.
errors.cause: `preventLazyLoading` on hai aur relation `with()` ke bina padha gaya.
errors.fix: Query mein `with('user')` jodo (yeh sahi tarah ki chetawani hai).

errors.error: Eager load karne ke baad bhi relation null aa raha hai
errors.cause: `with('user:name')` jaise column list mein `id` nahi rakha.

errors.error: Page bahut dheema hai (queries ki sankhya zyada)
errors.cause: N+1: loop ke andar relation lazy load ho raha hai.
errors.fix: `with()`/`load()` lagao aur query log se queries gino.

debug.body: Queries ginne ke liye query log, ya development mein Laravel Telescope/Debugbar jaise tools. Sabse seedha: `DB::enableQueryLog()`.

options: 1 query ki jagah N+1 queries chalna
quiz.why: Loop mein har item ke liye alag relation query chalti hai.

quiz.q: Eager loading ke liye kya use karte hain?
quiz.why: `with('relation')` saath mein relation laa deta hai.
Relation ko foreign/primary key se match kiya jaata hai.

interview.q: N+1 problem kya hai aur kaise solve karte hain?
interview.a: Loop mein har record ke liye alag relation query chalti hai. `with()` se eager loading karke 2 queries mein kaam hota hai.
`with()` query ke saath relation laata hai. `load()` model/collection milne ke baad laata hai.
Model ki har query mein diye gaye relationships automatically eager load karti hai.
Development mein lazy load par exception deta hai, jisse N+1 galtiyan jaldi pakdi jaati hain.

interview.q: Nested eager loading kaise karte hain?

summary: Loop mein relation property = N+1 queries.
`load`/`loadMissing` baad mein eager load karte hain.
